what: The 36 letter-list households whose id, household name or display name the corrected reading of a printed name moves. Generated once by tools/rename_household_ids.py --propose-t0638 and applied by --map; the tool re-derives every target id from the mint pass's own plain_fragment() before it writes, so this file cannot send a household somewhere its own tool would not.

faults.A: the printing put the SURNAME FIRST with no comma to say so, so the last token — a middle initial — took the family name's place in the id, the household name and the card's display name (T-0638 fault A)
faults.B: an apostrophe INSIDE one printed word was slugged as a separator, so M'Clintock sorted as m + clintock and Fred'k as fred + k (T-0638 fault B). The household name and the display name were already right; only the id moves.
